articles.title: U.S. CFTC sets policies on event contract data, using crypto to check financial boxes
articles.snippet: The derivatives regulator issues a rule on data reporting for event contracts and new guidance for how crypto assets can be used to meet regulatory requirements.

articles.title: Base makes quantum security a 2027 priority as regulators warn of risks
articles.snippet: Base creator Jesse Pollak says the upcoming Everest upgrade will help prepare wallets for future quantum threats, although further changes will be needed.

articles.title: MoonPay Applies for National Trust Bank Charter to Grow Custody and Stablecoin Business
articles.snippet: The crypto payments firm joins a rush of crypto companies seeking federal trust charters, which face growing political scrutiny.
